items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth. Evidence: the security baseline reports fleet-doctor with no run or results, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps unavailable, and all 59 security sitefacts unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS safety. Compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; it is not certification. Exact decision: retain private launch gates and block security-sensitive releases; permit only existing or bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and platform-policy boundaries. Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, exploit targets, or conduct outreach.

Security handoff: continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring and incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Preserve private launch gates. Do not create duplicate work, retrieve credentials, access private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.
